steps.description: Run calibration test — start at steady state and apply a step input to the HVAC system

suggestions: Start at a steady-state operating point before applying any input change.
Apply a step input (change input from 0 to a constant value) and hold for 3-5 time constants.
warnings: Do not apply sinusoidal or random inputs — use a step input for first-order system identification.

steps.description: Estimate system parameters — fit a first-order model (gain K, time constant τ) from step response

suggestions: Fit a first-order model: y(t) = K * (1 - exp(-t/tau)) * step_amplitude.
Use scipy.optimize.curve_fit with the exponential model to extract K and tau from the recorded response.

steps.description: Calculate PID controller gains using IMC or Ziegler-Nichols tuning based on estimated parameters
Run closed-loop PID control and verify setpoint tracking performance

suggestions: Run the simulator with PID control enabled and check that the temperature converges to the setpoint.
Compute performance metrics: overshoot (%), settling time, steady-state error.
